title: Coconut Cornmeal Cake (Bolo de Fubá com Coco)
description: An easy to make coconut cornmeal cake with a creamy center that it is to die for. It is basically prepared in the blender and baked. So comforting!

review.reviewBody: We were served this cake in Brasilia one time and it was delicious. I woke up with a craving for it, 8 years later, and had to make it! Glad I found your recipe, which was  way easier than most others I found. I cut the sugar in half and it was still too sweet for me, but otherwise delicious and a wonderful texture. Next time I’ll make with 1/4 of the sugar. Thank you!!!

Really enjoyed making this. Stumbled upon the recipe when I was educating myself on ‘Coconut Chess Pie’ which is apparently an American Southern recipe. From comparing the two recipes, they have similarities, as a custard-like pie, but differ in that the Chess Pie has a pre-baked crust, and this one makes it’s own crust. Also, the other doesn’t have the cheese, which is a great reason to try this one! I feel this is the better of the two (for me) as it is very tasty but not overly sweet. Exactly the kind of dessert I was looking for!
